Five-time champion — Pelé, 1970, and the yellow shirt as canon.

How Brazil national team connects

  • Character: Pelé — Pelé is the defining player of Brazil's World Cup lineage.
  • Topic: FIFA World Cup — Brazil is the World Cup's most titled national team.
  • Character: Ronaldo — Ronaldo led Brazil to the 2002 World Cup title.
  • Item: Jules Rimet Trophy — Brazil retired the Jules Rimet Trophy with a third World Cup in 1970.

What is Brazil national team?

Brazil is the World Cup's most titled side: 1958, 1962, 1970, 1994, and 2002, the Seleção of Pelé, the 1970 Mexico side, and Ronaldo's 2002 redemption.

Key threads lead to Pelé, FIFA World Cup, Ronaldo and Jules Rimet Trophy.
